description: This file is a PHP class that defines the controller for the shipping total extension in OpenCart's admin area. It contains methods for displaying the shipping totals configuration page and saving the settings.

classes.name: Shipping
classes.description: Controller class for managing the shipping total extension in the admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the shipping total extension configuration page in the admin area.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the shipping total extension settings via POST request, with permission checks, and returns JSON response.
